article.title: A surgeon kKilled, wards damaged: Inside Israel’s strike on Nasser Hospital
article.author: Editor
article.content: An Israeli strike killed six at Gaza’s Nasser Medical Complex, including a surgeon, and damaged surgery and intensive care wards. The post A surgeon kKilled, wards damaged: Inside Israel’s strike on Nasser Hospital appeared first on MR Online .
